query:
SELECT q.id, q.claim_id, q.panel_beater_name, q.quoted_amount, q.status, q.created_at,
       COUNT(qli.id) as line_item_count
FROM panel_beater_quotes q
LEFT JOIN quote_line_items qli ON qli.quote_id = q.id
WHERE q.panel_beater_name LIKE '%MP%' OR q.panel_beater_name LIKE '%Panel%' OR q.panel_beater_name LIKE '%panel%'
GROUP BY q.id, q.claim_id, q.panel_beater_name, q.quoted_amount, q.status, q.created_at
ORDER BY q.created_at DESC
LIMIT 20;
